theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_tc_truncation
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (R : ℝ), IsOpen U → 0 < R → closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R ⊆ U → IsIntegerMultiplicity S → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U m, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ ball 0 R → S.boundary ω = 0) → ∃ (ρ : ℝ) (Ŝ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), R / 4 < ρ ∧ ρ < R / 2 ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity Ŝ ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) ⊆ ball 0 ρ → Ŝ ω = currentEval S (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1))) ∧ (∀ β : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, tsupport (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ ball 0 ρ → Ŝ.boundary β = 0) ∧ (∀ O : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen O → Ŝ.massOn O ≤ S.massOn O) ∧ Ŝ.mass < ∞ ∧ Ŝ.boundary.mass < ∞
